question: Who created and last changed this custom field?

steps.name: entity
steps.soql: SELECT DurableId FROM EntityDefinition WHERE QualifiedApiName = '{obj}'

steps.name: field
steps.soql: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, TableEnumOrId, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM CustomField WHERE TableEnumOrId IN ({@entity.DurableId}) AND DeveloperName = '{name}'

verdicts.say: No custom field {name} on {obj}. Give the name without __c.

traps: On an org the field was deployed to, CreatedBy is the deployer. Read authorship on the org where it was built.
